title: Child with Toy Rifle on Porch, 1910s Snapshot, Black & White, USA
description: A black and white snapshot from around the 1910s depicting a young child dressed in early 20th-century attire with a large bow tie, seated on a small wheeled riding toy on a wooden porch. The child holds a toy wooden rifle upright. Dramatic long shadows of the photographer and another onlooker stretch across the porch floorboards in the foreground. In the background, outbuildings and a rural backdrop with bare trees and faint patches of snow or frost are visible.
